notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
The game is now live on Early Access, please help us improve it by reporting any issues or bugs.

We would also love to hear your experience and/or opinion, this way you can become part of the development of this game.

The game will retire from Early acess and pass to full release as soon as we finish the implementation of every level and breed, however this process is bound to the community, you can help us speed up or slow down development with your reports and opinions.

Thanks!
